name: Mobile viewport: Firby chat window opens cleanly with header and input bar visible
description: When a visitor on a mobile viewport (390x844 or 412x915) taps the chat launcher button, the full chat container expands visibly into the viewport showing the executive header and input area.

planSteps.description: Tap the floating Firby chat launcher button in the bottom right corner
Verify the chat window expands into view with the dark green gradient background, header title, close button, and active message container
Verify the text input field and send button are visible and accessible within the viewport bounds
